isolation.boundary: guest/public/dev routes only; no auth mutation

assertions.title: Restaurant thank-you aliases canonicalize to one public confirmation route

steps.expected: Legacy restaurant thank-you alias redirects to the canonical public thank-you route
Visible confirmation state appears on the canonical thank-you page
steps.observed: Rendered confirmation page titled 'Reservation Confirmed · Nab a Table'

evidence.network: Document ended at GET /restaurants/seed-perf-r001/book/thank-you?guestName=Ada&confirmation=REST123 -> 200; agent-browser request log did not expose a separate redirect hop, but final URL/browser state confirmed canonicalization

assertions.title: Recovery success strips the token from the final destination URL

steps.expected: Recovery harness should route through recovery and land on an entitled booking destination without an exposed token
Final authorized booking surface is shown token-free
steps.observed: Page text indicated redirect intent to sign-in with next=/bookings/22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222 rather than an authorized booking destination

evidence.network: Request log showed GET /dev/booking-recovery?fixture=active -> 200 with no visible document redirect chain to a token-free booking destination

assertions.issues: Recovery success did not complete on the live surface; the harness stayed on the dev recovery URL and exposed sign-in redirect intent instead of landing on the entitled booking destination.

assertions.title: Recovery flow preserves destination continuity end to end

steps.expected: Recovery/detail continuity harness should land on the intended internal booking surface
Entitled booking/detail continuity is visible without exposing recovery tokens
steps.observed: Page text surfaced sign-in redirect intent with next=/guest/bookings/55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555 instead of an entitled destination

evidence.network: Request log showed GET /dev/booking-detail-comparison?fixture=cancelled -> 200 and no redirect chain to the expected internal booking surface

assertions.issues: End-to-end destination continuity was broken on the live surface; the comparison harness stayed on the dev URL and showed sign-in redirect intent instead of the intended entitled booking view.

frictions.description: agent-browser network logs only exposed the final successful document request for the restaurant thank-you alias, so canonicalization evidence relied on final URL and visible browser state rather than an explicit redirect-chain entry.
frictions.resolution: Recorded final URL plus visible destination title and noted the network limitation in the assertion evidence.

summary: Tested 3 assertions: 1 passed, 2 failed. The restaurant thank-you alias canonicalized correctly, but both live recovery harness routes stayed on their dev URLs and surfaced sign-in redirect intent instead of reaching entitled token-free booking destinations.
